A 
work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Use Standard personnel safety equipment, goggles, rubber gloves, rubber apron, 
 eye rinsing device.
No smoking is permitted in battery room.
Do not place any tools on top of battery cells (Danger of short circuit)

Never use the same tools on these cells, you may use before on lead acid 
 cells.

sections.text:
Safety 
helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.

items:
Safety 
helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

Standard screwdrivers set, density meter, voltmeter, brushes, distilled water, 
 and rags.
Read overall voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card.
Disconnect AC supply to Battery charger.
Clean the dust of battery.

Check the electrolyte level and add distilled 
 water (if necessary) to the maximum level if the cells are completely 
 charged and to 10 mm below the maximum level if they are discharged.

Check the pole and connectors and clean any salt deposits with distilled 
 water.
Check that connections are tightened.

Lubricate the pole and connectors with Vaseline 
 including the disco and nuts.
Read voltage per cell and record on battery maintenance.

Inspect the electrolyte density and record on battery maintenance card (1.19 
 kg 1)

Again read overall voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card and 
 compare the reading from step no. 1

If overall voltage is below 220 volts place bank on float (high charge for 5 
 hours) after which you switch the charger back on normal charge.
Compare the present reading with the lost reading.

Check the temperature inside the battery room 
 not exceeding 45 C maximum and 20 C minimum.
Check the ventilation of the battery room to ensure their correct operation.
